source.title: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements: Vitamin B12 — Health Professional Fact Sheet

literal.prompt: Какое вещество, вырабатываемое париетальными клетками желудка, необходимо для нормального всасывания витамина B12?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NIH L58 explicitly identifies intrinsic factor as a B12-binding transport protein secreted by stomach parietal cells, with receptor-mediated distal-ileum uptake; L144–L147 describe malabsorption when factor is lacking. StomachL50–L52 independently distinguish parietal intrinsic factor from chief-cell pepsinogen. AccessoryL72/L75 distinguish pancreatic trypsinogen/trypsin and intestinal secretin. Only intrinsic factor simultaneously meets parietal origin and normalB12-absorption role, so key2 is unique. “Нормального” avoids claiming zero passive absorption at pharmacologic doses (NIH L128/L153–L154). Four named digestive substances are comparable noun labels.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Париетальные клетки желудка выделяют внутренний фактор, который связывает витамин B12. Образовавшийся комплекс распознаётся рецепторами и всасывается преимущественно в подвздошной кишке.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NIH L58 directly gives parietal secretion, binding to B12, resultant complex and receptor-mediated endocytosis in distal ileum. “Преимущественно в подвздошной кишке” is a cautious broader localisation, not a contradictory stomach-uptake assertion. Two sentences name intrinsic factor and explain the binding/uptake sequence. All relevant passage text is retained without its internal gaps occurring there.

StomachL46/L50 identify pepsin as protein-digesting enzyme and L52 supplies its pepsinogen origin; L110 explicitly says stomach protein breakdown usesHCl andpepsin. “Желудочная протеаза, расщепляющая белки” accurately describes this option, without falsely making it a parietal-cell secretion.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Секретин стимулирует выделение бикарбоната поджелудочной железой.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AccessoryL75 says acidic duodenal chyme causes secretin release, which causes pancreatic duct cells to release bicarbonate-rich juice. The note accurately condenses this as secretin stimulating pancreatic bicarbonate secretion and concerns secretin itself.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Париетальные клетки желудка выделяют внутренний фактор, который связывает витамин B12.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: NIHL58 explicitly calls intrinsic factor a transport/delivery binding protein secreted by stomach parietal cells and states freedB12 combines with it. The secretion part is already in prompt; binding is an additional concrete own-factor mechanism beyond merely being needed for normal absorption.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Трипсин образуется из панкреатического трипсиногена под действием энтеропептидазы в двенадцатиперстной кишке.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: AccessoryL72 states pancreatic protein enzymes are produced inactive, activated in duodenum, and brush-border enteropeptidase activates trypsin from pancreatic trypsinogen. Note preserves precursor, organ source, activator and duodenal location; it does not confuse trypsin with secretin or gastric pepsin.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество, вырабатываемое париетальными клетками желудка, необходимо для нормального всасывания витамина B12?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Какое вещество…? — Пепсин» is a grammatical standalone nominative substance label, like all alternatives. Its positive protease definition is grammatical.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Pepsin is a real stomach digestive substance; confusion with a vitamin-absorption helper is plausible to someone without gastric-cell knowledge.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: StomachL52 locates its precursor pepsinogen in chief cells, whereas parietal cells produce intrinsic factor (L50). Its protein-digestion role (L110) does not identify it as the parietalB12-binding factor of NIHL58, excluding it under the full prompt.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note teaches this option’s true own-enzyme class, gastric location and protein substrate, directlyStomachL46/L50/L110. It does not merely say pepsin is the wrong vitamin answer.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество, вырабатываемое париетальными клетками желудка, необходимо для нормального всасывания витамина B12?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Секретин стимулирует выделение бикарбоната поджелудочной железой.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Секретин» is the same nominative naming form; note subject/predicate and pancreatic bicarbonate object are coherent.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Secretin is a genuine digestive regulatory substance that affects pancreatic fluid, a credible secretion-versus-factor confusion.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: AccessoryL75 puts secretin release in response to duodenal acidic chyme and its effect on pancreatic ducts; NIHL58 andStomachL50 identify the parietalB12-binding substance specifically as intrinsic factor. Secretin does not meet both prompt conditions.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: The note positively explains secretin’s own bicarbonate-stimulation function; exact causal sequence is atAccessoryL75, with bicarbonate-rich pancreatic juice contextL70.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество, вырабатываемое париетальными клетками желудка, необходимо для нормального всасывания витамина B12?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Париетальные клетки желудка выделяют внутренний фактор, который связывает витамин B12.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Внутренний фактор» is a correct noun label for the named substance and its note is a grammatical complete sentence.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: The true specific binding factor must be distinguished from two proteases and a hormone; all labels are actual digestive substances and no answer-form clue gives it away.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: NIHL58 directly names parietal-secreted intrinsic factor bindingB12 and distal-ileum receptor uptake, reinforced byStomachL50–L51. “Нормальное” absorption preserves ordinary physiology rather than universal absence of any high-dose passive uptake. Unique key2 follows this exact conjunction.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Note’s new own-option fact is binding toB12, not merely parietal secretion already supplied in the prompt. NIHL58 directly establishes this binding step; it materially explains how the factor supports absorption and may repeat in explanation.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.prompt: Какое вещество, вырабатываемое париетальными клетками желудка, необходимо для нормального всасывания витамина B12?
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: Трипсин образуется из панкреатического трипсиногена под действием энтеропептидазы в двенадцатиперстной кишке.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Трипсин» is a parallel nominative digestive-substance label; note precursor/activator construction is grammatical.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: Trypsin is a real digestive protease and intestinal digestion participates in B12 processing, making confusion plausible unless origin and binding role are distinguished.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: AccessoryL72 gives pancreatic trypsinogen and duodenal activation, so trypsin is not made by stomach parietal cells. Even though digestive enzymes releaseB12 fromhaptocorrin (NIHL58), that does not make them the distinct parietal binding factor asked for.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: Note gives this option’s exact activation pathway: pancreatic trypsinogen, enteropeptidase, duodenum, allAccessoryL72. It is a concrete true fact about trypsin itself.

absoluteLevel.individualGround: Intrinsic factor links a specific gastric cell type to a specific micronutrient transport/absorption mechanism. Broad knowledge that the stomach digests food or small intestine absorbs nutrients is insufficient. Knowledge of chief/parietal/pancreatic origins can exclude proteases, and knowledge of endocrine secretin can narrow further, leaving the specific binding factor. This is specific gastrointestinal physiology knowledge with meaningful elimination, satisfying HARD without demanding an arbitrary number or specialist treatment protocol.

correctNoteExtraFact.beyondPromptAndKey: Prompt already supplies parietal-cell origin and requirement for normalB12 absorption, but not direct binding. Binding is a concrete own-protein mechanism adding to that dependency; NIHL58 states it explicitly. Repetition with explanation is permitted.
